title: n8n error alerts for small teams: who gets told, what they see, and how to avoid alert fatigue
summary:
Most small teams find out an automation broke the same way: a customer asks why nobody replied to their form, or the finance person notices invoices stopped arriving in the sheet. By then the workflow has been failing quietly for days.
n8n has everything you need to catch this early. The hard part isn't the feature. It's deciding who gets an alert, what the alert says, and how to keep alerts rare enough that people still read them. This is the setup I use for small teams on self-hosted n8n.
